title: ServiceNow Elevates Employee Experience with AI-Driven Talent & Workplace Enhancements Featuring VergeSense Integration
summary: Discover how ServiceNow's new AI-driven HR and workplace features, integrated with VergeSense occupancy insights, elevate employee experience and space optimization.
body_markdown:
By: International Business Times


ServiceNow introduces cutting-edge AI-powered tools to enhance talent development, employee experience, and in-person collaboration—powered by real-time occupancy data from VergeSense to optimize workplace utilization.
